vehicle.notes: Measured on one car with a WiCAN and firmware/tools/obd_probe.py. Other W205 variants / years likely share the broadcast signals but are unverified.

bus.notes: The OBD port carries a LIVE vehicle bus (100+ broadcast IDs), not an isolated diagnostic bus. Everything below under 'signals' is read by listening only. The bus goes quiet a few seconds (ignition position 1) to about a minute (position 2) after the engine stops; with the engine running it stays awake.

signals.name: odometer
signals.verified: matched the instrument cluster and the Mercedes app at two different readings

signals.name: range
signals.verified: matched the instrument cluster and the Mercedes app at two different readings; falls by 1 km every few minutes while idling

signals.name: outside_temperature
signals.verified: 0x5E = 7.0 C, matched the cluster; stable across two recordings. Same message as the odometer.

signals.name: fuel_level
signals.verified: matched the Mercedes app at 68 % and 66 %; still to check after a fill-up (should read about 100)

signals.name: interior_light
signals.verified: on while any door is open, off about 2 s after closing

signals.name: locked
signals.verified: listen-only recording, locked and unlocked with the key once

signals.name: battery_voltage
signals.verified: 12.0-12.1 V engine off, 12.8-12.9 V while starting, 14.8 V running (three recordings); dips by 0.1-0.2 V while window motors run or hazards blink

signals.name: reverse_gear
signals.verified: listen-only recording, reverse engaged once (manual gearbox)

signals.name: parking_brake
signals.verified: listen-only recording: applied at start, released and applied again once

signals.name: light_switch
signals.verified: listen-only recording, switch turned through every position left to right; bit 0x04 is set while the front fog light button is pressed (0x05 seen twice)

signals.name: fog_light_button
signals.verified: set briefly twice when the fog light button was pressed (momentary, not the lamp state)

candidates.guess: unknown: 62-68 in early recordings, 81-82 later with the engine running; not fuel level, not voltage (voltage is 0x122)

candidates.name: brake_pedal
candidates.guess: set while the brake pedal is pressed; 0x087 bytes 2-5 also ramp like brake pressure at the same time

candidates.name: driver_seatbelt
candidates.guess: set for ~2.4 s between two marks, probably belt buckled then unbuckled (marks had no notes)

candidates.name: start_stop_enabled
candidates.guess: cleared when the ECO Start/Stop button was pressed and set again on the second press (byte 3 goes 0x60 -> 0x20 at the same time)

candidates.name: not_on_this_bus
candidates.guess: turn signals, hazard lights, power windows and the clutch pedal did not show up (no blinking or switching bits); they live on the comfort/body CAN
door state again, 2-bit fields in two multiplexed frames; 0x33F is simpler

candidates.name: tpms
candidates.guess: tyre pressures (cluster showed 240/230/260/255 kPa) are NOT in the stationary logs - the TPMS sensors sleep when parked and only refresh while driving
candidates.status: needs a sniff while driving above ~25 km/h

candidates.name: service_interval
candidates.guess: ASSYST PLUS 'Service A in N days' (cluster showed 115 days); value 115 is NOT on the broadcast bus
candidates.status: diagnostic only - held in the cluster, read via UDS (not continuously broadcast); would need the cluster's DID, which is on a Mercedes-specific CAN ID that must not be probed by sweeping

number_formula: value = raw * scale + offset (offset defaults to 0)

obd.notes: The engine ECU answers mode 01 only on the functional address 0x7DF, not physically on 0x7E0 (UDS service 22 on 0x7E0 works).

answers.0x2030: raw 0x0298..0x0365 seen; NOT fuel level (another W205 shows the same range at about 53 %), meaning unknown
answers.0x2017: raw 200 with a cold engine, probably / 10 = degC (the OBDb formula gives 94 degC, wrong)

never_transmit.notes: Frames sent to normal message IDs on this bus are acted on. A tester-present / read-DID sweep over raw CAN started a Mercedes service call and unlocked the doors (unlock right after a frame on 0x245). Only listen, and only send OBD/UDS requests to the known diagnostic IDs above.
